dog.description_text: Handsome Denver is a 1 year old, 48 pound Poodle mix who was found alongside the road with his mom, Dani, and littermate, Dixie, by a worker from our partner shelter. These are some of the sweetest dogs we have ever met! Denver is gentle, loving, and happiest getting all the affection and attention from people and other dogs. The three share such a sweet bond, and each is now learning the ropes in their fown oster home as we get to know their individual personalities. Denver has been neutered and vetted and has started a nutritious diet to help him gain some healthy weight. We can’t wait to watch this handsome boy continue to blossom and find a forever family to love! He is a foster home with both older children, and other dogs!
dog.name: Denver
